note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it was pinned (npm run qa:cover-recipes re-renders it and fails when median d or the moving share leave +-15 %, seamLocal leaves TARGET or the file passes 2 MiB). Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung and libwebp 1.6.0.
base: fixtures/cover/painted-light-base.png in this skill (1536x1024, the five-panel painting the PAINTING block was measured on; QA only, not packed); a different painting needs its own PAINTING block

treatment.request: Make the LitFamily README motion cover from the painted robot line-up.
treatment.idea: A window of work light walks the sleeping bays while the lead robot breathes and a comet laps its frame.
treatment.recipeReason: The painting already carries the brand, so the loop relights it instead of drawing over it.

layers.slow: A comet laps the lead frame and motes rise one screen per loop.
layers.mid: A sharp-edged light window walks the bays once per loop, with scan bands at two passes.
layers.beat: Eyes breathe twice, one blink, and the LIT. flare pulses at t = 0 and 0.5.

system.rule: One light window and one scan band rule.
system.offset: Each panel's phase comes from its x position.

treatment.ambition: Light reads as moving edges that survive the encoder, and the seam disappears under the flare.

feather-150.defect: A 150 px soft light edge: the window reads as a soft wash instead of a moving edge. At this recipe's encode (q83, edge q97 for 18 frames) the encoder keeps the soft edge, so no motion gate sees it: it measured moving 1.0 and a seamLocal inside run-to-run noise of the 2.0 TARGET, like the recipe's 1.965 at 24 px. What it reliably trips is the 2 MiB size TARGET. The wash itself is caught by look review on the sheet, not by a gate.
